positions.name: Donaldson Company, Inc.

The verified 3.24 vs 2.22 figure is a GAAP-basis comparison. So the bull case here rests entirely on the raised sales guide and the price action, not on the quarter. Pre-market book is 128.12/132.20, a 3.2% spread. Overnight only, and this is the position I would cut first if the open is soft.
positions.driver: Tier 1: earnings gapper on a raised sales outlook
